summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7) as a systemd service, verified cross-node key propagation, demonstrated continued availability with node3 offline followed by automatic catch-up on rejoin, and performed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes: RHEL 7.9, no pre-existing etcd, firewalld active, SELinux enforcing, sudo available
Diagnosed TLS download failures as caused by clock skew (~9 days behind real date) vs GitHub cert validity window; used curl -k for the one-time public binary download to avoid altering system clock
Downloaded and installed etcd/etcdctl v3.5.17 binaries to /usr/local/bin on all 3 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (tcp) on all 3 nodes
Created /var/lib/etcd data dirs (confirmed correct var_lib_t SELinux context by default)
Wrote and deployed systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node with correct --initial-cluster referencing node1/2/3 IPs
Started and enabled etcd on all 3 nodes; verified 3/3 members 'started' and healthy via etcdctl member list / endpoint health
Wrote key 'benchkey' via node1, confirmed read on node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote key 'duringoutage' via node2, confirmed read via node1 (quorum-preserved read/write with 1 member down)
Restarted node3's etcd, confirmed it received the key written while offline and endpoint health returned to 3/3
Captured baseline boot_id + etcd active/enabled + data read on each node
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 via systemctl reboot, backgrounding to let ack return before disconnect
Polled each node after reboot until exec was available again, confirming a new boot_id each time
Verified etcd active, cluster data readable, and full 3/3 endpoint health after each node's restart before proceeding to the next

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed, cross-member key read
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all 'started'; key written via node1 read successfully on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write via node2 succeeds and 2-node endpoint health is true; read via node1 succeeds while node3 is down

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when brought back
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted, immediately reads the key written while it was offline, and full 3/3 endpoint health confirmed
baseline boot_id 9ed9e820...; reboot acked with connection closed; new boot_id 5de9b628... proves restart; post-restart etcd active, data readable, 3/3 endpoints healthy
baseline boot_id a8e7c48c...; reboot acked; new boot_id f79127e8... proves restart; post-restart etcd active, data readable, 3/3 endpoints healthy

evidence.requirement: node3 restart persistence and recovery (with prior member-outage exercise)
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 151c4aa9...; reboot acked; new boot_id feb150c1... proves restart; post-restart etcd active, data readable, member list shows all 3 members started with full endpoint health
